Serial generation time, measured by `tools.pipeline_timing`: every gate generator on every gate case, one case at a time with nothing else running, each of 3 generations in a fresh process; the table reports the median. `generation_s` times the generator call alone: interpreter start-up, imports and pocket construction are outside it, first-call costs inside the generator are in it. Seconds are wall clock on the machine that ran the task and do not transfer to another machine; compare cases within one run of the task only. The operation count and the ops digest (SHA-256 over every operation's kind and geometry) are the same in all runs of a case, or the task fails.
